The Destination

Untouched, Exclusive
& Unforgettable

Located off the remote north-east coast of Madagascar, Nosy Ankao is a pristine private island offering one of the most exclusive and untouched experiences in the Indian Ocean. Surrounded by turquoise waters and part of a protected marine area, Nosy Ankao is defined by its powder-soft beaches, lush vegetation and remarkable sense of seclusion.

Accessible only by air, this extraordinary island destination is ideal for travellers seeking privacy, barefoot luxury and immersive nature experiences in a truly remote setting.

Natural Beauty

Untouched Wilderness

Nosy Ankao forms part of a secluded archipelago along Madagascar’s north-east coastline — an area known for its rich biodiversity both on land and beneath the sea. The island’s landscapes range from palm-lined beaches and coastal forests to mangroves and coral reefs, creating a diverse and unspoilt environment.

The surrounding marine ecosystems are among the healthiest in Madagascar, with vibrant coral gardens, abundant fish species and regular sightings of dolphins, turtles and seasonal humpback whales. On land, the island is home to a variety of birdlife and endemic flora, offering a tranquil and immersive natural experience.

Experiences

Things to Do
in Nosy Ankao

Snorkelling & Diving

Discover thriving coral reefs just offshore, where crystal-clear waters reveal an underwater world rich in marine biodiversity. The area is ideal for both beginner snorkellers and experienced divers.

Helicopter & Island Excursions

Explore the surrounding coastline and remote mainland areas by helicopter, offering access to untouched beaches, waterfalls and wildlife-rich forests that few travellers ever experience.

Deep-Sea Fishing & Ocean Adventures

The waters around Nosy Ankao are renowned for sport fishing, with opportunities to catch species such as tuna, sailfish and marlin. Private ocean excursions can also be tailored for exploration and relaxation.

Wildlife & Nature Experiences

Enjoy guided walks and excursions that highlight the region’s unique ecosystems, from coastal forests to nearby reserves on the mainland.

Beach Picnics & Private Experiences

Indulge in personalised experiences such as private beach picnics, sandbank excursions and sunset gatherings in completely secluded settings.

Wellness & Relaxation

Unwind in a peaceful environment with wellness treatments, yoga sessions and uninterrupted time surrounded by nature.

Where to Stay

Accommodation in
Nosy Ankao

Nosy Ankao — Accommodation

Accommodation on Nosy Ankao is designed to reflect the island’s exclusivity and natural beauty, offering a seamless blend of comfort, privacy and refined island living. Properties are set discreetly along the coastline, ensuring uninterrupted ocean views and direct access to the beach.

Spacious beachfront villas with private pools and expansive outdoor living areas
Elegant, contemporary design incorporating natural materials and local craftsmanship
Fully personalised service, including private chefs and tailored daily experiences
Exceptional dining featuring fresh seafood and locally sourced ingredients
Access to a wide range of curated activities, both on the island and on the nearby mainland
Some of the island’s premier accommodation offerings provide an all-inclusive, highly personalised experience, where every aspect of a guest’s stay is carefully curated — from adventure and exploration to relaxation and wellness.

As part of a bespoke journey with The Madagascar Collection, Nosy Ankao can be combined with other regions across Madagascar to create a diverse and unforgettable itinerary — balancing remote luxury with cultural discovery and natural exploration.

When to Visit

May – October
Dry season. Calmest conditions, best visibility for diving and snorkelling.
November – April
Warmer and greener. Seasonal humpback whales. Occasional rain.
Year-Round
Nosy Ankao is a year-round destination. TMC will advise on the best timing for your interests.
